title: Can Place Flowers
goal: Decide whether n new flowers fit without adjacent occupied slots.
strategy: Greedily occupy the earliest safe empty slot; this leaves at least as much room for later flowers.

phasePurposes.inspect: Greedily occupy the earliest safe empty slot; this leaves at least as much room for later flowers.
phasePurposes.update: Every planted flower preserves an empty neighbor on both sides.
phasePurposes.done: Every planted flower preserves an empty neighbor on both sides.
